concepts.definition: The ability to move a joint actively with control through its full, pain-free range.
Techniques to restore mobility: compression, joint and stretching mobilization.

questions.q: How does mobility differ from flexibility?
questions.a: Mobility is active, controlled range at a joint; flexibility is the passive length of tissues.
